name: Shuto Street Racer
summary:
Shuto pushes the Quest to its limits, to bring you the biggest, most realistic looking racing game on standalone VR. Realtime reflections, dynamic lights and shadows, PBR shaders, working mirrors, day night cycle, and dense AI traffic

For many, experiencing Tokyo car culture is a dream. Now you have the chance to live that dream

Three main gameplay modes:

Show off your skills in the addictive traffic cutting mode
